# OAuth 2.0 v3 — operations

3 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `oauth.get-access-token` — **Get Access Token** — `POST /oauth/token` (write, no auth, form)
  Use Access Tokens to access CRM resources on behalf of an authenticated location/company.
- `oauth.get-installed-location` — **Get Location where app is installed** — `GET /oauth/installed-locations` (read, agency)
  This API allows you fetch location where app is installed upon
- `oauth.get-location-access-token` — **Get Location Access Token from Agency Token** — `POST /oauth/location-token` (write, agency, form)
  This API allows you to generate locationAccessToken from AgencyAccessToken
